room.name: Brake Below the Teeth
room.hint: Down-Right dash, then Jump Left · Brake Right over the bed; fall below the wall.
room.question: How long can you keep the speed before the safe way forward becomes down?

bank.entrance: Small eastern launch ledge under a thorned roof.
bank.exit: Lower west corridor beneath the hanging wall.
bank.author: Codex
bank.solution: Use the outward down-diagonal dash to take the tally and reverse its jump into a low, fast hyper. Begin countersteering while still above the long thorn bed; the remaining leftward momentum clears it. Drop into the receiving bay without reaching the hanging thorn face too high, then leave underneath to the western exit.
bank.nearestExisting: Precision low hyper tunnels teach staying low, while F31 returns across alternating phase shores. Here the landing is below a hanging wall: speed is required for the long low crossing, then must be shed in flight to enter the vertical receiving slot.
bank.novelty: The reverse hyper solves the entry height and direction; it is not the last decision. Continuing to hold the launch direction hits the wall, but braking too early fails to clear the bed. The successful route changes from a horizontal throw to a controlled drop.
bank.designNotes: No phase device or moving hazard. The launch window spans four timings and the braking window spans five timings at each launch. Later launches shift the visible braking point. A fast low trajectory and controlled drop are the objective; an equivalent advanced alternative is legitimate.
